branches.conclusion: The entire current graduate catalogue programme inventory was read. College of Business and Technology awards are MBA, executive MBA, MA, MS and graduate certificates. Clinical/education doctorate plus MBA combinations are not business research doctorates.

The full university graduate inventory contains no engineering or Operations research doctorate. Listed doctorates are Education and Leadership, Nursing Practice, Occupational Therapy and Physical Therapy, plus combinations with masters or the partner institution osteopathic medicine award.
